title: Define Fleet kernel primitives and resource graph
description: Define the Fleet kernel model: Cluster, Graph, Node, Edge, Request, Allocation, Lease, Binding, and Agent; settle ownership, materialized indexes, endpoint fencing, and deterministic replay requirements.

logs.msg: Vetted one cohesive vocabulary against Flux, Slurm, Kubernetes, Nomad, Borg, and Chubby terminology. Working model: Cluster → Graph → Node/Edge → Request → Allocation → Lease → Binding → Agent. Allocation is the concrete selected set; Lease is committed authority; Binding is endpoint enforcement. Rejected Cell, Placement, Plan, AllocationPlan, NodeIncarnation, and FenceToken for the kernel draft.

Accepted v0 kernel contract in ai/design/kernel-primitives.md. Settled Cluster authority, Allocation claims vs Lease, exclusive occupancy (discrete devices/cores, quantified Memory), rebuildable indexes, command log, optimistic commit on graph_revision plus free claims. Deferred renewal/fence/partition protocol to tk-l8xd.
